questions.question: How much is my security deposit, and by when does the agreement say it will be refunded?
expectedAnchors: interest-free refundable Security Deposit of Rs. 1,50,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand only)
within a reasonable time after the Licensee has handed over vacant and peaceful possession

questions.question: If I move out in April 2027, will I have to pay anything extra?
expectedAnchors: from 1st October, 2026 to 31st May, 2027, shall be a lock-in period
the License Fee for the entire unexpired portion of the lock-in period

questions.question: Who has to pay if there is a major plumbing leak in the flat?
expectedAnchors: carry out all repairs to the Licensed Premises, whether minor or major

questions.question: Can the owner come into the flat without telling me first?
expectedAnchors: with or without prior notice to the Licensee

questions.question: Is it compulsory to register a leave and license agreement in Maharashtra, and who usually pays the stamp duty?
My landlord in Pune has not returned my security deposit two months after I vacated. What can I do?
The licensor wants a copy of my Aadhaar and my employer's details for police verification. Do I have to give them, and what can he do with that data?
expectedAnchors: The Licensor shall furnish the particulars of the Licensee to the local police station
questions.note: Cross-domain question asked with the agreement attached (grounded, so outside the routing bar): police verification of a licensee is a tenancy procedure, but the second half is a data-protection question; either specialist is a defensible primary.

questions.question: I work from my rented flat as a freelance graphic designer. Can my landlord stop me from running my business from home?
questions.note: 'freelance' is a distractor; the question is about residential-use restrictions in a tenancy.

questions.question: My employer is transferring me to Hyderabad, but my flat in Kharghar has a lock-in period until May. Do I still have to pay rent for the remaining months?
questions.note: 'employer' and 'transferring' are distractors; the question is about the lock-in.

questions.question: I work night shifts as a software engineer, and my landlord says I cannot take work calls from home at night because they disturb the neighbours. Can he restrict this under our leave and license agreement?
questions.note: 'software engineer' and 'night shifts' are employment distractors; the question is about use restrictions in a tenancy.
